diagram_previews.alt: An arc of the first circle with A, B, C, D, E equally spaced; the blue arc of the circle centred at C runs from E through F, G, H, I to A inside the first circle. Red segments form angle ABD, green segments angle AHG, magenta segments angle BAG, and dashed segments join C to A, G and E.

difficulty_rationale: Two circles must be linked through one angle that is inscribed in one and central in the other; then a short angle computation.
